ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast ratio; approximately 70% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the central and medial regions with 30% high-intensity (light gray/white) distribution at the lateral distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous black central region. Distal tips (left and right) exhibit high-contrast white-to-light-gray mottling. Distinct dark linear streaks (rake marks) are mapped within the lighter zones on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated internal angle of approximately 75 degrees and a deep vertical bounding-box penetration.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge. Frequency of peaks increases toward the medial notch. Prominent irregular undulations with a pixel amplitude of 5-10 pixels are visible on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Primary trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in a sharp downward taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density, roughly circular, high-contrast white pixel clusters consistent with barnacle colonization located at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, unaligned diagonal linear marks (rake-style abrasions) visible on the light-colored surface of the distal tips on both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle growth creating a highly textured, irregular perimeter on the outer tips of both lobes.
